page.layout: One printed page on the right: top running head and page number; below them a verse list of 14 couplets, a small italic summary line, a centred division heading, and a paragraph opening with a woodcut initial; catchword at lower right. The strip at the far left is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Sechs d' Epistel und' Galater/ Dergleichen sechs an d' Ephefer. Die zu philipp hand vier empfangen So vil auch an d' Colosser glangen. Beid so an Thessalonich geschriben/ Bey fünff vnd dreyen sind geblíben. ◆ Die zwen Sendbriess Thimothei Sechs vnd vier/ drey d' greifft des Tit. Philemonis eins/ an d' Hebreer Dreyzehne/ fünff Sanct Jacobs Lehr Sanct Peter zwo Epistel gmacht/ Fünffer vnd dreyer hab gut acht. Bey Sanct Johanse.1 findst du drey/ Fünff Capitel der ersten sey/ Der andren jede mit eim verfaß/ Alu 9 schreibt vns nur eins Sanct Judas Zwenzig zwey d' Offenbarung g rempt. Ist d' sum Im Neuwen Testament.

p.i: Hactenus de omnibus libris N. Testamenti in genere: sequitur

main_text.head: DE SCRIPTIS EVANGELI-starum.
main_text.p: EVANGELII vox ob εὐ[?] & ἀγγέλλω, I. felicia annuncio, Græcis quemuis bonum & optatum nuncium declarans, hoc in loco, pro læta & felici exhibi-ti Messiæ dudum promissi, tamdiu à populo Dei expeti & expectati, annunciatione seu revela-tione accipitur.

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to "VANGELII" as "EVANGELII". The Greek in "ob εὐ" is partly unclear; the accent and breathing are uncertain. The mark ◆ after "geblíben" is a printed symbol in the verse. The verse is set in a German-influenced roman with irregular letterforms, so several words are doubtful, e.g. "Dergleichen", "Thessalonich", "Johanse.1", "Alu 9". The line "Bey Sanct Johanse.1" may be a printing error for "Johanse.s" or a numeral reference. The left strip is the neighbouring page and is omitted.
